info.name: backend_pomodoro_task
info.description:
Collection para validar contratos e rotas públicas do backend Pomodoro.

Pré-requisitos:
- importar também o environment `backend_pomodoro_task.postman_environment.json`;
- preencher `api_key`;
- ajustar `base_url` conforme o ambiente.

Fluxo recomendado:
1. Health
2. Groups > List
3. Activities > List by Group
4. Activities > Next
5. Activities > Start Current
6. Activities > Active
7. Activities > Status Current
8. Activities > Complete Current
9. Queue > Skip Current
10. History

A collection tenta propagar automaticamente `group_id`, `activity_id`, `queue_item_id`, `queue_id`, `schedule_id` e `execution_id` entre as chamadas.
